title: Deterministic graph snapshot (ATLAS-22, Slice 2)
description: Standalone, versioned graph-projection document. It is NOT wrapped in a transport envelope: a consumer loads this document directly. Identifiers are projection-local and are explicitly NOT canonical entity identifiers (PO decision D9; Confluence page 05 is unresolved). This schema expresses structure only. Deterministic identifier derivation, canonical ordering, identifier uniqueness and edge referential integrity are additionally enforced by src/gbrain-read-contract/validate.mjs and are not expressible here.

id_component.description: A component of a projection-local identifier. The restricted charset excludes the ':' separator, so composition is transparent and decomposition is unambiguous without escaping.

source_ref.description: Provenance anchor: the identifier of the origin object inside the source.

label.description: Human-readable display text. Deliberately not identifier-constrained.

relation_type.description: Syntactically constrained relation token. Deliberately NOT an enum: the canonical relation-type catalog is an open point on Confluence page 08 and is not decided by this contract.

origin.description: Preserves the explicit/inferred distinction required by Confluence page 08. V1 admits explicit relations only; inferred relations are rejected and none are generated.

canonical_entity_ids.description: Machine-visible boundary marker: these identifiers are projection-local and never the final canonical entity identifiers.

source_id.description: For source_kind confluence this is the project's registered root page id.
